text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Kalendar Akademik 2024/2025) 2023.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi

pendidikan kecuali di sekolah ekspatriat dan sekolah antarabangsa bagi kalendar

akademik 2024/2025.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi kalendar akademik 2024/2025 adalah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

 Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor,

Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu

10 Mac 2024 hingga 23 Mei 2024

Penggal Kedua

3 Jun 2024 hingga 12 September 2024

Penggal Ketiga

 22 September 2024 hingga 19 Disember 2024

29 Disember 2024 hingga 16 Januari 2025

Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Melaka,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak,

Perlis, Pulau Pinang, Sabah, Sarawak,

Selangor, Wilayah Persekutuan

Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan

Labuan dan Wilayah Persekutuan

Putrajaya

11 Mac 2024 hingga 24 Mei 2024

Penggal Kedua

3 Jun 2024 hingga 13 September 2024

Penggal Ketiga

23 September 2024 hingga 20 Disember 2024

30 Disember 2024 hingga 17 Januari 2025

Dibuat 3 November 2023

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(44); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

 FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

 Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS

ACADEMIC CALENDAR 2024/2025) REGULATIONS 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions except

at expatriate schools and international schools for the academic calendar 2024/2025.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the academic

calendar 2024/2025 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

 Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Johore,

Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu

 10 March 2024 to 23 May 2024

Second Term

 3 June 2024 to 12 September 2024

Third Term

22 September 2024 to 19 December 2024

29 December 2024 to 16 January 2025

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Academic Calendar 2024/2025) Regulations 2023.

 Group B First Term

All educational institutions in Malacca,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak,

Perlis, Penang, Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor,

Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur,

Federal Territory of Labuan and

Federal Territory of Putrajaya

11 March 2024 to 24 May 2024

Second Term

3 June 2024 to 13 September 2024

Third Term

23 September 2024 to 20 December 2024

30 December 2024 to 17 January 2025

Made 3 November 2023

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(44); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

 FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

 Minister of Education
